::: {#sol-gpt2-size}

```{python}
#| code-fold: show
d_model, vocab_size, context, n_blocks = 768, 50_257, 1_024, 12
block = nn.ModuleList([
    nn.LayerNorm(d_model),
    nn.MultiheadAttention(d_model, num_heads=12),
    nn.LayerNorm(d_model),
    nn.Linear(d_model, 4 * d_model),
    nn.Linear(4 * d_model, d_model),
])
per_block = sum(p.numel() for p in block.parameters())
embeddings = vocab_size * d_model + context * d_model
final_norm = 2 * d_model
gpt2_params = embeddings + n_blocks * per_block + final_norm
block_weights = 12 * d_model**2
block_rest = per_block - block_weights
print(per_block, block_rest, embeddings, gpt2_params)
```

Building one block from PyTorch's layers and counting its [parameters](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/big-ideas.html#def-parameter) gives `r format(py$per_block, big.mark = ",")` per block.
Of these, the attention's four $d \times d$ weight matrices hold $4d^2$,
and the [MLP](feedforward-networks.qmd#def-feedforward-network)'s two weight matrices hold $8d^2$,
`r format(py$block_weights, big.mark = ",")` in all.
The biases and the two [layer normalization](normalization.qmd#def-layer-norm)s hold the other `r format(py$block_rest, big.mark = ",")`.
The token and position [embedding](rnns.qmd#def-embedding)s hold `r format(py$embeddings, big.mark = ",")`,
and a last [layer normalization](normalization.qmd#def-layer-norm) holds $2d$.
In all,
GPT-2 has `r format(py$gpt2_params, big.mark = ",")` parameters,
the 124 million that Hugging Face lists for it [@hf_gpt2].
The output layer adds none,
since it reuses the token embedding.

:::
